notes:
- **Your monthly spending limit now also pauses reading new mail and texts**, not only routines. A
  routine at the limit stays quiet instead of posting the limit message each time it's due, and your
  agent tells you once, at the end of an answer, when the month reaches your limit. Reminders you set
  still go off.
- **A shaky connection to the AI company no longer fails your request halfway.** Archie sends it
  once more on a fresh connection. If it still can't get through, the message now mentions a VPN.
- **Asking for the same reminder twice at the same time sets one reminder**, not two.
- **On iMessage, your agent can have an Apple ID of its own**, which you text like a contact, so
  nothing shows twice. In the conversation with yourself, its replies now start with its name. The
  Connecting iMessage guide shows both ways.
- **Agents on Telegram, Slack, and Matrix can write tables again.**
- **Telegram and Slack no longer preview a link your agent wrote**, so neither opens an address
  before Archie has asked you about it.
- **An email your agent read for you can no longer shape a search in your next message.** For about
  ten exchanges after it reads new mail or catches up on a group chat, a search it would hand on, or
  a site you name in passing, waits for your yes.
- **A note your agent saves after reading something you didn't write is labeled**, so you can tell
  where it came from.
- **When your agent buys something, the total is read off the checkout page itself**, and it won't
  press the button if the total went up after you tapped.
- **If Archie loses its place in a mailbox, it tells you** which mail went unread, that every email
  is still in your inbox, and to ask your agent for it.
- **With your own AI key, a paused free trial no longer stops your 20 free jobs a day.**
- **When a plan ends, the screen that asks for one has a Save a backup button.**
- **A calendar add-on's Connect button asks Google for your calendar only**, not your Gmail, and
  connecting an account again through a setup button keeps what it already had.
- **On the talk screen, click anywhere or press the space bar to cut your agent off.**
- **On Windows, opening Archie again brings the open copy forward** instead of starting a second one.
- **The store and the guides say the same things in about half the words.**
- **Fixed:** connecting Google failed on an agent that already had an Outlook account; the free jobs
  counter fell behind your replies, and one notice said "You was"; a one-line answer showed a fade
  under it; and long file names pushed the Knowledge tab past the edge of the window.
- **Fixed: deleting your account went ahead even when your plan couldn't be canceled.** It now stops
  and says so, so nothing keeps charging.
